description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。更多信息，请参见[如何保证幂等性](~~25693~~)。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

description.zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器的实例ID。
description.en: The ID of the simple application server.

description.zh: 升级后的套餐ID。您可以调用[ListPlans](~~189314~~)查询套餐信息。
description.en: The ID of the new plan. You can call the [ListPlans](~~189314~~) operation to query the plans provided by Simple Application Server.

description.zh: 指定的轻量应用服务器所属的地域ID。
description.en: The region ID of the simple application server.

descriptions.zh:
- 仅支持升级为更高配置的套餐。关于套餐的更多信息，请参见[计费项](~~58623~~)。

- 调用该接口升级服务器时，您需要确保您的阿里云账户余额充足，否则会升级失败。
descriptions.en:
- The plan of a simple application server can only be upgraded. For more information about plans, see [Billable items](~~58623~~).

- Before you call this operation, make sure that the balance in your account is sufficient. If the balance in your account is insufficient, the upgrade fails.
